name: Shigure Kanako
source: Third-year student at Keifuu Academy and resident of Flying Fish Manor dormitory, Kanako is a very beautiful girl though she is a very lazy person - much to Aoi's chagrin, she likes to walk around in the dormitory only in her underwear. When she is interested in something, it doesn't take much time for her to get bored.
